title: settings.yaml asks for LAN exposure: reported, never a pass
titleZh: settings.yaml 要求 LAN 暴露:必须报出来,绝不能 pass
why: networkExposure=lan is outside the design (the link must not need any LAN surface) and the setting selects a wider HTTPS edge intent. The collector must surface it as a non-pass finding with a restorable remediation, and it must never be reported as a plain pass just because the desktop web server happens to be hard-wired to loopback.
expectSummary: DSH_NETWORK_EXPOSURE blocked/exposure_lan with a rollback, never pass, exit 2
